timing: Formal runs use --in-process, serially. Each timed method has one warmup and three measurements. Algorithm timings include internal preprocessing and exclude input generation, independent checking, and process/IPC startup. The 30-second algorithm limit is soft: a completed over-limit call is marked limit_exceeded. HiGHS uses one thread and an internal 30-second limit; LP end-to-end time includes model construction and the linprog wrapper call. The retained child-worker mode is diagnostic only.
